note: Steps 17 and 18. One label per failing run, and where the fix belongs. Agent failures are fixed in the harness; infra failures are fixed in the scenario, runner or grader and never counted against the model. Labels follow the corpus: Meta's per-round findings log ([Agent] trigger, jargon, incorrect, wasted-calls; [Infra] sim-deviation), the Grok CLI feedback categories (overeager, stopped_early, hallucinated, stuck_in_a_loop) and Anthropic's hill-climb buckets (artifact gap, grader disagreement, harness, structural, variance). The ids match the page's diagnoser and evals/report.py.
